import datetime as dt,hashlib,json,os,subprocess,time
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(r'C:\Users\27933\.codex\worktrees\architecture-convergence-recovered\ClawX')
RUN=Path(__file__).parent
def git(*args):return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],cwd=ROOT).decode('utf-8').strip()
assert not git('status','--porcelain'),'Commit fixes before clean-candidate verification.'
candidate={'commit':git('rev-parse','HEAD'),'tree':git('rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'),'dirty':False}
OUT=RUN/('candidate-'+candidate['commit'][:9]);OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
(RUN/'current-run.txt').write_text(str(OUT),encoding='utf-8')
RT=ROOT/'openclaw_runtime';SPEC='harness/specs/tasks/architecture-review-and-integration.md'
env={**os.environ,'TEMP':'D:/tmp','TMP':'D:/tmp','TMPDIR':'D:/tmp','GOMAXPROCS':'4','UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE':'2','pnpm_config_verify_deps_before_run':'warn','COMMS_OUTPUT_DIR':str(OUT/'comms')}
tests=['product-semantics','evidence-refs-exist','semantic-authority-consistency','contract-check','architecture-small-cycles','architecture-runtime-cycles','context-engine-registry-default-on','architecture-authority-convergence','component-authority-manifest','component-disposition-catalog','model-capability-profile','identity-scope','permission-effect-contract','default-config-matrix','workspace-runtime-sync','workspaces-api','sandbox-api']
owners=['task-loop-controller','routing-memo','orchestration-plan-ledger-projection','task-loop-upgrade','task-ledger-reference','task-ledger-reference-inheritance']
def unit(names,id,extra=[]):return ['node','node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs','run',*['tests/unit/'+x+'.test.ts' for x in names],*extra,'--maxWorkers=1','--reporter=verbose','--reporter=json','--outputFile.json='+str(OUT/(id+'.json'))]
commands=[
 ('contract-tests',ROOT,unit(['contract-check'],'contract-tests')),
 ('architecture-tests',ROOT,unit([name for name in tests if name!='contract-check'],'architecture-tests')),
 ('owner-tests',ROOT,unit(owners,'owner-tests',['tests/integration/p1-orchestration-boundary.integration.test.ts','tests/integration/task-loop-checkpoint-evidence.integration.test.ts'])),
 ('capability-tests',ROOT,unit(['model-capability-effective-state-tf0512'],'capability-tests')),
 ('runtime-tests',RT,['node','scripts/run-vitest.mjs','run','--config','test/vitest/vitest.unit.config.ts','src/context-engine/enhancement-kill-switch.test.ts','src/context-engine/chat-turn-vtoken-injection.test.ts','src/context-engine/assembler.kill-switch.test.ts','--maxWorkers=1','--reporter=verbose','--reporter=json','--outputFile.json='+str(OUT/'runtime-tests.json')]),
 ('versebrowser-types',ROOT,['node','node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc','-p','packages/versebrowser/tsconfig.build.json']),
 ('bridge',ROOT,['node','scripts/generate-ext-bridge.mjs']),
 *[('typecheck-'+name,ROOT,['node','node_modules/@typescript/native-preview/bin/tsgo.js','--noEmit','-p','tsconfig.'+name+'.json','--composite','false']) for name in ('node','web','test')],
 ('contract',ROOT,['node','scripts/contract-check.mjs']),
 ('authority',ROOT,['node','scripts/check-semantic-authority.mjs','--report',str(OUT/'authority.json'),'--actor','codex-architecture-review']),
 ('evidence',ROOT,['node','scripts/check-evidence-refs.mjs']),
 ('evidence-report',ROOT,['node','scripts/check-evidence-refs.mjs','--report',str(OUT/'evidence-report.json'),'--actor','codex-architecture-review']),
 ('evidence-verify',ROOT,['node','scripts/check-evidence-refs.mjs','--verify',str(OUT/'evidence-report.json')]),
 ('cycles',RT,['node','--import','tsx','scripts/check-import-cycles.ts']),
 ('loc',RT,['node','--import','tsx','scripts/check-ts-max-loc.ts','--max','500','--baseline','scripts/ts-max-loc-baseline.json']),
 ('comms-replay',ROOT,['node','scripts/comms/replay.mjs']),
 ('comms-compare',ROOT,['node','scripts/comms/compare.mjs']),
 ('lint',ROOT,['node','node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js','scripts/contract-check.mjs','scripts/check-evidence-refs.mjs','tests/unit/contract-check.test.ts','tests/unit/evidence-refs-exist.test.ts','tests/unit/architecture-authority-convergence.test.ts','--max-warnings','0']),
 ('retention',ROOT,['node','scripts/check-repository-artifacts.mjs']),
 ('harness-context',ROOT,['node','harness/src/cli.mjs','context','--spec',SPEC]),
 ('harness-validate',ROOT,['node','harness/src/cli.mjs','validate','--spec',SPEC]),
 ('harness-dry-run',ROOT,['node','harness/src/cli.mjs','run','--spec',SPEC,'--dry-run']),
 ('diff',ROOT,['git','diff','--check','c97ea58faf2e66cc52cabe1df7f9c5b31bc387cd']),
]
results=[]
for name,cwd,argv in commands:
 assert git('rev-parse','HEAD')==candidate['commit'],'Candidate moved; stop before reusing results.'
 assert not git('status','--porcelain')
 start=time.monotonic();started=dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat()
 with (OUT/(name+'.stdout.txt')).open('wb') as stdout,(OUT/(name+'.stderr.txt')).open('wb') as stderr:
  proc=subprocess.Popen(argv,cwd=cwd,env=env,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr)
  while proc.poll() is None:
   try:proc.wait(timeout=30)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:print(json.dumps({'running':name,'pid':proc.pid,'seconds':round(time.monotonic()-start)}),flush=True)
 result={'id':name,'cwd':str(cwd),'argv':argv,'candidate':candidate,'startedAt':started,'durationSeconds':round(time.monotonic()-start,3),'exitCode':proc.returncode,'afterDirty':bool(git('status','--porcelain'))}
 for stream in ('stdout','stderr'):
  p=OUT/(name+'.'+stream+'.txt');b=p.read_bytes();result[stream]={'path':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'text':b.decode('utf-8')}
 results.append(result)
 (OUT/'gates.json').write_text(json.dumps({'driven_by':'agent','actor':'codex-architecture-review','candidate':candidate,'gates':results},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
 print(json.dumps({'id':name,'exitCode':proc.returncode,'seconds':result['durationSeconds'],'afterDirty':result['afterDirty']}),flush=True)
 assert not result['afterDirty']
 assert git('rev-parse','HEAD')==candidate['commit'],'Candidate moved during gate; result is not frozen-candidate acceptance.'
raise SystemExit(int(any(r['exitCode']!=(1 if r['id']=='loc' else 0) for r in results)))

import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(r'C:\Users\27933\.codex\worktrees\architecture-convergence-recovered\ClawX')
OUT=Path(__file__).parent
history=json.loads((ROOT/'harness/specs/fixtures/architecture-authority-convergence/acceptance/report.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
audit=json.loads((ROOT/'harness/specs/fixtures/architecture-authority-convergence/gap-classification.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
ref=history['candidate']['commit'];rows=[]
for row in audit['rows']:
 raw=subprocess.check_output(['git','cat-file','blob',ref+':'+row['source']],cwd=ROOT)
 assert hashlib.sha256(raw.replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')).hexdigest()==row['sha256']
 assert row['anchor'] in raw.decode('utf-8').splitlines()[row['line']-1]
 current=(ROOT/row['source']).read_text(encoding='utf-8');assert row['anchor'] in current
 rows.append({'target':row['target'],'historicalHashVerified':True,'historicalLineVerified':True,'currentAnchorPresent':True})
(OUT/'historical-gap-replay.json').write_text(json.dumps({'driven_by':'agent','actor':'codex-architecture-review','historicalCandidate':ref,'currentCandidate':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip(),'rows':rows,'historicalEvidenceChanged':False},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'historicalCandidate':ref,'verifiedHistoricalRows':len(rows),'currentAnchors':len(rows)}))

import hashlib,json,os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
MAIN=Path(r'D:\ClawX');OUT=Path(__file__).parent/'merge-plan'
p=json.loads((OUT/'plan.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
def git(*a):return subprocess.check_output(['git',*a],cwd=MAIN)
def sha(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
assert git('branch','--show-current').decode().strip()=='main'
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==p['oldMain'],'Main advanced; refresh and test candidate first.'
assert not git('diff','--cached','--name-only').strip()
actual=set(git('diff','--name-only','-z').decode().strip('\0').split('\0'))-{''}
assert actual=={x['path'] for x in p['dirtyPaths']},'Dirty path set changed; refresh preservation plan.'
for row in p['dirtyPaths']:
 path=MAIN/row['path']
 if row.get('missing'):assert not path.exists()
 else:assert sha(path.read_bytes())==row['sha256'],row['path']+' changed after plan'
assert subprocess.run(['git','merge-base','--is-ancestor',p['oldMain'],p['target']],cwd=MAIN).returncode==0
overlap={x['path']:x for x in p['overlap']}
# Only the verified overlapping files are temporarily at HEAD; other edits remain in place.
# Every original and its three-way result is already backed up before this operation.
for row in p['overlap']:
 assert sha((MAIN/row['path']).read_bytes())==row['beforeSha256']
 (MAIN/row['path']).write_bytes(Path(row['base']).read_bytes())
result=subprocess.run(['git','merge','--ff-only','--no-stat',p['target']],cwd=MAIN,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
(OUT/'merge.stdout.txt').write_bytes(result.stdout);(OUT/'merge.stderr.txt').write_bytes(result.stderr)
now=git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()
if result.returncode:
 assert now==p['oldMain'],'Unexpected partial merge; preserve backup and inspect.'
 for row in p['overlap']:
  assert (MAIN/row['path']).read_bytes()==Path(row['base']).read_bytes(),'Concurrent file changed; do not overwrite.'
  (MAIN/row['path']).write_bytes(Path(row['before']).read_bytes())
 raise SystemExit('Fast-forward refused; original overlapping files restored. Inspect merge stderr.')
assert now==p['target']
for row in p['overlap']:
 assert (MAIN/row['path']).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')==Path(row['new']).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n'),'Unexpected post-merge content; preserve it.'
 (MAIN/row['path']).write_bytes(Path(row['combined']).read_bytes())
assert not git('diff','--cached','--name-only').strip()
verified=[]
for row in p['dirtyPaths']:
 path=MAIN/row['path']
 if row.get('missing'):assert not path.exists();continue
 expected=overlap[row['path']]['combinedSha256'] if row['path'] in overlap else row['sha256']
 assert sha(path.read_bytes())==expected,row['path']
 verified.append(row['path'])
for name in p['untrackedBefore']:
 if name:assert (MAIN/name).exists(),name
record={'driven_by':'agent','actor':'codex-architecture-review','oldMain':p['oldMain'],'newMain':now,'mergeExitCode':0,'dirtyFilesPreserved':len(verified),'overlappingFilesCombined':list(overlap),'stagedChangesAfter':0,'untrackedPathsPreserved':len([x for x in p['untrackedBefore'] if x]),'mergedArchitectureBranch':True}
(OUT/'landing.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False))
